annotation.bound_parties_text: The Regulation binds entities and individuals engaged in unmanned aircraft flight and related activities, including designers, producers, importers, owners, operators and pilots of unmanned aircraft systems, as well as government authorities responsible for management.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 在中华人民共和国境内从事无人驾驶航空器飞行以及有关活动,应当遵守本条例。
annotation.dates_quote: 现公布《无人驾驶航空器飞行管理暂行条例》,自2024年1月1日起施行。
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 为了规范无人驾驶航空器飞行以及有关活动,促进无人驾驶航空器产业健康有序发展,维护航空安全、公共安全、国家安全,制定本条例。
